system.description: You may steal the form of any predator you personally kill, provided you drench your body in its fresh blood (requiring at least one Blood Trait remain in the corpse). You gain any Physical Traits the creature had that you lack, and exchange Gorgeous, Bestial or Repugnant Traits for its equivalents, along with its shape, size and non-magical senses. This grants no Disciplines or magical abilities the creature had. You may maintain a slain creature's skin as long as you wish, but once shed for your own form, you cannot regain it.
